steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Sir! We've brought the hostage!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: It really is you, old man.

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: He put up a fierce fight and even wounded one of our men, but we didn't hold back. We made him bleed.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Alright, you did a pretty good job out there. Now get back to work.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Capitán, the fact that this old man made it up to the sixth floor means that there must be a lot of them. We might not... be able to...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Might not be able to what? Let me be clear with all of you: if this doesn't come together, we're done for!

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: One other thing. I have no idea what this guy was doing, with all these wires running inside the wall...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Stop asking questions and get back to work.

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Yessir...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Alright, Diaz. What brought you and your men over to the Galería?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: You already know the answer to that, Mateo.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: We've rescued the hostages, and your minions have been taken out. It won't be long until all of Dossoles knows that it was you who orchestrated and staged this terrorist attack.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Basically, you're finished.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: You can't fool me.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: You can't think you're going to ship those art pieces for a quick buck, can you?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Listen, of all the trucks you brought, only a single one is loaded, and we've already got the driver and guard. Your get-rich-quick scheme is ruined.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: If you don't believe me, just ask the men you sent downstairs. We already knew about the bombs, so let's wrap things up here before they blow.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: The bombs... Reynell, when are your bombs supposed to go off? Give me the time.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Tell me when the bombs go off, Reynell.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Talk! Are you a deaf-mute now?!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: If you're that desperate to get blasted to pieces, I can fulfill your wish right here and now–

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Ten o'clock.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Give it up, Mateo. You'd better figure out what you're going to do, because there's not much time left.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: If you have a shred of sanity left, let me out of these cuffs.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: There are four bomb caches in the building, three of which we have under control. They'll be defused in no time. We're short the one in the ventilation shaft of Reynell's office.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Miserable old man, if I find out you're lying to me, you're dead meat!
The Capitán swears viciously and grabs the terminal before striding over into the shadow by the wall of the office.
The old firefighter looks up at the sky; Reynell finds his usual posture, leaning comfortably beside a huge painting.
An awkward silence lingers over the balcony.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Diaz.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: So you can still speak after all.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: How do you know when the bombs are supposed to go off? Who told you?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Why? Are you upset you can't use explosives to turn your investors' money into scrap paper?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It doesn't make a difference. There's another node in the ventilation shaft.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It might not be enough to destroy the artwork downstairs, but it is enough to turn this whole gallery into rubble and send that money up in smoke.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: It's also enough to end the lives of the men up here on the balcony.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: In the face of what I'm about to accomplish, does that really matter?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Diaz!
Though she has already steeled herself, Ela can't help but feel a chill grip her heart the moment she sees what's in front of her.

A large hole has been dug out on the side of the stairwell, and the multitude of metallic appendages protruding from it sprawl over the ground, a number of them crushed by people who had fallen to the ground.
But even more conspicuous is the blood spilled on the floor of the stairwell.
A trail of blood that has already begun turning black around the hole it emerges from extends all the way upstairs.
Before Ela can pick up her terminal to report the situation, the ground beneath her suddenly starts shaking.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: ...Oh no!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: *Cough,* *cough*...

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Ela, what's going on up there?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: It's as you feared. The explosives in a half-connected state went out of control and started detonating, causing a small-scale collapse.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Are you hurt?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'm fine, but the site of the explosion doesn't look good. It might get in the way of–
Ela walks down a few steps. Before she can finish her sentence, the gravel and rubble tightly choking the stairwell come squarely into view.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: What happened just now? What exactly is the situation up there?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: (*deep breath*) The collapse caused by the explosion has completely sealed off the stairwell between the fifth and sixth floors.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Considering that Reynell bastard designed only one stairwell to the upper levels of Galería Krysztauowa, and his elevator is out of commission, I'm cut off from the rest of you.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Doc and I are here at the explosion too–– My god, what is this...?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Solutions first. Can the stairwell be cleared with the tools you have?
Ela tries to push the large slab of concrete in front of her.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: ...Not easily.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Wait for me, I'll be there in a second. Tecno and Miłosz are also on the way. We're going to find a way to clear the rubble.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: But... It's 9:35 right now. We're running out of time.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'll break through and make my way up. You guys follow after me as soon as you clear the rubble. If you can't do that in time, I'll at least find a way to get Diaz out safely.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Wait, Ela! That's way too dangerous!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Think this through carefully, Ela.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: I'll give it to you straight – clearing through the debris might take longer than expected.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: My point exactly. We can't sit around waiting for Diaz to get blown to pieces, can we?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Are you sure you can do this?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Of course. I trust all of you, and I also trust in myself.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Sounds good to me.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Iana? Doc?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (*smiles wryly*) Looks like nobody can stop you.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Please be careful.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Hm, static?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: My communicator seems like it's about to die. Fuze, after we get out of this mess, make sure to charge it up for me.

steps.name: Grumbling Soldier
steps.text: I've about had it with this stupid place. Climbing stairs on my first day, and now I'm still climbing stairs on my last.

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: If you want out, then pick up the pace.

steps.name: Grumbling Soldier
steps.text: Also, what was that loud noise with the tremors just now? Seemed like the whole building was shaking.

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Quit wasting time. Hurry up and head down–
The soldiers, eager to head downstairs, suddenly run into Ela in the not-so-wide corridor.
Both sides immediately raise their weapons.
Ela aims her muzzle at the leader, but her target is the only one among the soldiers who does not respond.

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Out of the way, Reynell's bodyguard. We're short on time.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What a coincidence. I'm in the same boat.

steps.name: Grumbling Soldier
steps.text: Wait, didn't el Capitán tell us to–

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Bodyguard, you saw the hole in the wall and those wires on the sixth floor, didn't you? What is that?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Explosives. Reynell planted enough explosives in the building to flatten the whole place. Now, out of my way.

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Coño, I knew it!
The irate soldier heads down the stairs with increased urgency, while the others stand there in a daze, not having grasped the link between the art gallery and the bombs.
Ela also pays them no heed. She tries to push past the group of soldiers with her shoulders.

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Hold on! This isn't right!

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Stop that woman right now! Hurry!
Despite their bewilderment, the soldiers still subconsciously spring to carry out the order, grouping up to surround Ela.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What are you getting at now?

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Coño! The path right under us is blocked!

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: You know how to get out of this place, right? Take me with you! Hurry! Otherwise, we're both going to die here!
Ela swears under her breath.
The men in front of her clearly can't be reasoned with, yet she is the one caught in the most disadvantageous position.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I finally got through! Hurry up and report! Now!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Conchetumare! Did everyone go deaf today?!

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Sir... Have you known about the explosives in the art gallery... this entire time?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: It was news to me too! Just give me your report, now! We have ways of dealing with the explosives!

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: There's nothing to report.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: WHAT?!

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: If I had to say something... it'd be that the only staircase going down is completely sealed off. Over.
The soldier slams the communicator into the ground in a fit of rage.

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: No one is taking orders from el Capitán anymore, so you'll get us out of here, right? You must know the way out?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You've got it wrong. I'm going upstairs to save a life, not running for my own.

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Drop the act already! There's no way you're fooling all of us. You must know the way out!
The leader's words become more and more jumbled, but the routed soldiers start to understand, one after another.
Laying the GRZMOT mines, getting out of the blast zone, then swiftly coursing her way out before the soldiers can act. Ela has planned it all out in her head.
Her actions might invite another group of pursuers, but there is no other option. With each second she wastes here, Diaz's peril continues to grow–

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Grenade out! Brace for impact!
At almost the same instant the order leaves her lips, Ela leaps and vaults over the stair handrails.
Just on the other side of the ignored wall, a grenade soars through the air and finds a place to lodge itself, ripping apart the surface.
The soldiers, their attention drawn away by Ela, do not notice the wall behind them until they are bowled over by a surge of shattered bricks, sweltering heat, and shockwave.
Before they can turn their weapons to the gaping hole in the wall, or even stand, the well-trained squad has already rushed in under the cover of their ballistic shields.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Go, go, go!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Laying suppressive fire!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Hostile down!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Stragglers at three o'clock!

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Hostile down! One more below us! Watch for friendly fire!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Clear.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Good work.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Ela, are you alright?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Cohen, Tina, Kötz, Alexsandr...

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: See, I told you Ela would be inside. We couldn't have come at a better time.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Ugh, looks like we have a good number of stragglers on our tail outside the stairwell... How's the situation on your end?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I was just on my way to the roof to free the hostage. Explosives go off at ten o'clock.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Where are the others?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: The smaller explosion before sealed off the only staircase.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Understood. We'll trace your steps after we finish off the hostiles pursuing us.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Hey... Thank you all so much, really.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Words aren't enough.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: To be honest, Diaz, I was rather fond of what you people were doing in the street art community.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: And you think now is the time to bring that up?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: If not now, when? Which side would you take on the subject of explosives?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: You've lost your mind.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I'm being serious. You've got some good stuff over there.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Are you not afraid of death at all?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I've already fulfilled my life's calling. What is there to be afraid of?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Then again, you seem pretty composed yourself. At least, nothing like that lily-white captain over there. Why is that?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: I found a place where I truly belonged, and lived out a long enough life there.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: If I manage to survive this mess the two of you joined hands to make, I'd like to see my community rise again from the ashes. If not, all I can say is, too bad.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You have that much confidence... in the street artists?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Simple answer. They're my family, and I know them well. As long as we're together, anything is possible.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: What, do you not have any people like that around you?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I did... But when we were together, we only ever did what I wanted...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Mateo, your people should've told you what you need to know on the phone, so you should understand the situation.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Hurry up and let me disarm the node. At least that way, neither of us has to die.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Not going to happen, old man.
Mateo turns to Reynell, who is leaning to the side, a somewhat twisted expression on his face as he grabs a golf club.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Reynell, you wouldn't want your carefully-crafted fireworks show to go to waste, right?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: (*takes a deep breath*)

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: We'll make a two-in-one deal. You promise me that you'll blow this place to bits at the scheduled time, and I'll let you and the old man over there hold onto your lives.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I know you're the only person who can access the elevator in your office. Nobody else, not even Miłosz.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Now, all you need to do is give me the elevator key and let me go down, and I'll let you and the old man leave. Considering...
Mateo glances at the clock above his head. It reads 9:50.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: ...we have plenty of time.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Don't go quiet on me now. You two were so chatty a minute ago?
Reynell blinks a few times.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You really want me to say what I think?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Mateo, do you know my greatest fear? What I'm most worried about here?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: The elevator key, now––

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: My greatest fear... is that the filthy blood flowing out of your corpse could seep into the rubble and pollute all the art.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Shut up! And give me the key!

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Mateo, stop! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Don't move, or I'll mess you up too.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Urk... *cough*, *cough*!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It's fine, Diaz... Let this sad little man, *cough*, blow off some steam.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: The key! Don't make me say it again!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You know, Mateo. I just thought of the perfect analogy.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I didn't ask, you–

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You're like a bloated burdenbeast that has broken into a solemn memorial hall, stinking up the whole place without a care in the world, so proud of yourself as you watch everyone cover their mouths and noses with their handkerchiefs.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You feel like you're the one in control, since they're all acting that way because of you.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Just like right now. You think that as long as you offer me a deal, I'll give in to your coercion because I'm desperate to escape. You think that old Diaz and I will watch you disappear down the elevator, and despair as we struggle to get downstairs. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Unfortunately, at the end of the day, a burdenbeast is nothing more than a domesticated animal.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I said, shut up–

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: If you're in that much of a hurry to make it downstairs, I'd suggest jumping down the elevator shaft–

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: SHUT UP!
In a fit of rage, Mateo strikes Reynell with a heavy blow to the back.
Diaz, his hands still bound, tries to rush up to Mateo, but is kicked away.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Don't get too excited... The two of you can settle down...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: After all, we're going to become monuments to Galería Krysztauowa in a few short minutes.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I SAID SHUT UP!!
Mateo lifts the golf club in his hand high up into the air again, this time taking aim at the back of Reynell's head.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Frag grenade out!

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Throwing flashbang!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Who's that?!
For a moment, a loud boom and a blinding light fill the spacious balcony.
After the dizziness and tinnitus gradually fade away, the people on the balcony see a woman – furious, yet nevertheless silent – step out from behind the wall.
There once was a painting there, now replaced only by the smoldering remnants of a frame.
The canvas, blasted to pieces, swirls around the woman as if her silent rage had converged into a firestorm.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Successfully broken through to the balcony on the top level of the art gallery.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Three individuals on the balcony: Diaz González, Reynell Kowalski, and...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: ...a sad little clown.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Everyone, cover me. This will be our final mission.
